knownAmbiguitiesLimitations: The notification lists POSH guidelines but does not provide a dedicated A2 sample or a full POSH teaching text; statutory items use the official India Code Act.
Question 005 uses the existence and athlete-welfare purpose of SAI’s 24 June 2026 policy. The direct policy PDF should be opened and catalogued centrally before release.

Questions 031–040 use the official 2025 Act text. Section 1(2) states that commencement is by Gazette notification; the bank does not assume that every provision was already in force on the as-of date.
Question 032 uses the statutory abbreviations NOC and NPC to keep four options comparable in length; the explanation spells out all four bodies.
The IOC safeguarding resources are international guidance, not a substitute for SAI’s internal reporting procedure or Indian statutory advice.
